items.question: What must one do after seeing a dream while lying on a darbha bed at night?
premises: One has gone to lie on a darbha-grass bed at night.
While there, one has seen a dream.
A prescriptive injunction requires reporting what has been seen.
items.inference: Therefore, after seeing a dream in that state, one should report it.
uncertainties: The intended recipient of the report is not specified in this verse.
items.plain_english: Having gone to lie on a bed of darbha grass at night and having seen a dream, one should report it.
